title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.62: Swap now moves FULL STACKS with no 10 cap. One Swap trades one whole debuff stack of yours to enemies for one whole buff stack from each enemy; 'Swap N times' trades up to N distinct stacks per side. Best of Both / Pass the Mic / Living the Dream now full-swap their N rightmost debuffs (still Invert all), so their Swap-count picks distinct stacks instead of raising an amount cap.
